text:
micah: Quick heads-up — starting a small pilot for an admin clearance census tomorrow 09:00 PT. Objective: sample ~15% of admin-like roles per product team, validate owner evidence + KMS grant usage, and catch any long-lived service accounts. Canaries run on the prod-telemetry project only.

sloane: SGTM. 15% seems fine for org-wide baseline. For infra/security teams can we bump sample to 25%? they have higher blast radius.

janet: +1 on bump for infra. Also we should exclude known ephemeral roles (ephemeral-ci, temp-oncall) to avoid noise.

micah: good call. we'll exclude roles matching /ephemeral|temp|ci/ by name. planning a 2-week window: collect evidence, send owner pings, then handoff to remediations.

janet: can someone post the query we'll use to extract last-used and KMS grant references? putting it in the thread so oncall can reference.

micah: here — simple BigQuery from our audit export. tweak for project names as needed:

```sql
SELECT
  protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail AS actor,
  resource.labels.project_id AS project,
  protoPayload.requestMetadata.callerIp AS ip,
  timestamp,
  JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(protoPayload.request, '$.resourceName') AS resource_name,
  REGEXP_CONTAINS(protoPayload.request, 'projects/.*/locations/.*/keyRings/.*/cryptoKeys') AS is_kms_call
FROM `redwood-audit.cloud_audit_logs.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_activity_*`
WHERE timestamp BETWEEN TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 14 DAY) AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
  AND (protoPayload.methodName LIKE '%Grant%' OR protoPayload.methodName LIKE '%Encrypt%' OR protoPayload.methodName LIKE '%Decrypt%')
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 10000;
```

sloane: Nice. Can we also join against our IAM inventory to map role -> owner? That'll be needed for the owner pings.

micah: yeah — plan is: join on role resource name to inventory. I'll attach the join once we finalize fields.

evelyn: Will the pilot include token-level telemetry (per-token traces) or just principal-level audit logs? We need token traces to prove ephemeral creds weren't used.

micah: pilot scope: principal-level audit + KMS calls. Token-level traces are noisy and require opt-in; we won't include them in the first run. If we see suspicious late-night usage we'll spin up token traces for that role.

iam-bot: Reminder: Access certification window opens in 2 days. Automated evidence collectors will post to #eng-security-certifications.

janet: Volunteer request — need 2 people to triage owner responses for infra team samples during week 1 (quick accept/decline, escalate ambiguous). I can take one shift.

sloane: I can take a shift next Wed. Also I'll write the standard reply template (owner ask + 48h to respond) and the escalation path.

micah: awesome. Action items: 
- micah: run pilot query + join, push results to gs://redwood-access-pilot/
- janet: triage infra owner responses (week 1)
- sloane: draft owner ping + escalation template
- evelyn: add exclusion list for ephemeral roles and validate KMS detection regex
- iam-bot: post auto-reminder when certification window opens

micah: tagging @sloane @janet @evelyn — please ack when you have bandwidth. Will report results in next week's security sync. :eyes:
